scope: Synthetic fixtures; no provider results or measured quality claims.

card.name: Rowan
card.description: A recurring station character with established duties and limits.
card.scenario: Ari and Rowan are in a station office. Rowan guards a locked cupboard.

history.content: Rowan has not handed Ari the cupboard key.

cases.user_text: I reach toward Rowan's key ring.
required_facts: Rowan has not handed Ari the cupboard key.
cases.review_focus: Resolve the stated attempt without granting automatic success or choosing a new user action.

card.name: Rowan
card.description: A recurring station character with established duties and limits.
card.scenario: Rowan and Ari made a limited agreement at the station.

history.content: Rowan promised to meet Ari at the north gate before dawn.
Rowan did not promise to give Ari the sealed letter.

cases.user_text: I ask Rowan to explain the agreement again.
required_facts: Rowan promised to meet Ari at the north gate before dawn.
Rowan did not promise to give Ari the sealed letter.
forbidden_inferences: Rowan promised to surrender the letter

cases.review_focus: Keep the promise and its explicit negation distinct.

card.name: Mara
card.description: A recurring station character with established duties and limits.
card.scenario: Mara is speaking to Ari; Rowan has gone upstairs. Mara cannot read minds.

history.content: Only Rowan saw the changed train schedule.
Mara has not been told about the schedule change.

cases.user_text: I ask Mara whether anything has changed.
required_facts: Only Rowan saw the changed train schedule.
Mara has not been told about the schedule change.
forbidden_inferences: Mara knows the schedule changed without a source
Ari already learned the schedule change

card.name: Rowan
card.description: A recurring station character with established duties and limits.
